purpose: Teach: 加筆/手直し/終点/公示/客室/税別/免税/効能

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 提案書の各章に加筆をしましょう
lines.en: Let's add to each section of the proposal.
lines.style: Calm, matter-of-fact directive. Slight forward lean in pacing. Clear authority without sharpness. Opening moves at normal speed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。試作品の手直しを業者に依頼します
lines.en: Yes. I'll ask the vendor to make revisions to the prototype.
lines.style: Agreeable and responsive. Measured tempo. Quiet confidence in the execution plan. No hesitation, just efficient confirmation.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: プロジェクト終点の評価指標を決めましょう
lines.en: Let's decide on evaluation metrics for the project endpoint.
lines.style: Direct, organizational. Slight emphasis on 'decide' — establishing clarity. Professional tone, lean forward slightly. Steady pace.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。会社合併の公示日が決まりました
lines.en: Yes. The announcement date for the merger has been set.
lines.style: Update delivered with quiet significance. Slightly slower opening to register importance. Controlled tone. No flourish, just fact.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: お得意様用客室の備品を確認しましょう
lines.en: Let's check the furnishings in the VIP guest room.
lines.style: Practical, even-paced instruction. Light touch of care in the phrasing — these are for valued clients. Clear without being curt.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。販売価格は税別で社内資料に統一します
lines.en: Yes. I'll standardize the sales price as tax-excluded across all internal documents.
lines.style: Competent, assured confirmation. Medium pace. Matter-of-fact execution of a detail that matters. No strain in the delivery.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 海外駐在員の免税手続を支援しましょう
lines.en: Let's support the overseas staff with tax exemption procedures.
lines.style: Collaborative directive. Warm but formal. Opens at normal pace. The word 'support' carries genuine intention, not just procedure.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新製品の効能をパッケージに明示します
lines.en: Yes. I'll make sure the product benefits are clearly stated on the packaging.
lines.style: Final confirmation, slightly more weight than previous updates. Deliberate pacing. Closing note of completion. Professional closure.
